title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.14046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure. To address this, we propose two complementary approaches to directly attack and defend against confidence structure deformation. First, building upon the traditional loss maximization perspective, we introduce a hybrid objective that integrates cross-entropy and KL divergence, encouraging adversarial examples to simultaneously disrupt prediction accuracy and distribution consistency. Second, we geometrically reconstruct adversarial training by generating perturbations that maximize the distribution distance on the confidence manifold. Theoretical analysis shows that the optimal perturbation direction aligns with the principal eigenvectors of the Fisher information matrix. We also propose an efficient algorithm to avoid high-dimensional matrix computations. Experiment

translated_title: 基于费舍尔几何的结构化置信度扰动对抗训练
translated_abstract: 对抗训练常常受到“伪攻击”的困扰，这类扰动虽能显著增加损失值，却无法真正改变模型的置信度结构。为解决这一问题，我们提出了两种互补的方法，可直接攻击并防御置信度结构的变形。首先，在传统损失最大化视角的基础上，我们引入了一种融合交叉熵与KL散度的混合目标函数，促使对抗样本同时破坏预测准确性与分布一致性。其次，我们从几何角度重构对抗训练，通过生成在置信度流形上最大化分布距离的扰动来实施攻击。理论分析表明，最优扰动方向与费舍尔信息矩阵的主特征向量对齐。我们还提出了一种高效算法，以避免高维矩阵计算。
tldr: 该论文针对对抗训练中的“伪攻击”问题，提出融合交叉熵与KL散度的混合目标，并基于费舍尔信息矩阵几何在置信度流形上生成最优扰动，理论证明最优方向为费舍尔信息矩阵主特征向量，同时给出避免高维矩阵计算的高效算法。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses "pseudo-attacks" in adversarial training by proposing a hybrid cross-entropy and KL divergence objective, and geometrically generating perturbations that maximize distribution distance on the confidence manifold via Fisher information geometry, theoretically showing the optimal direction aligns with principal eigenvectors of the Fisher matrix, along with an efficient algorithm avoiding high-dimensional matrix computations.
